title: Hot Spicy Canadian Chicken Skewers
description: A spicy and light Canadian dish featuring miso-marinated chicken, peanut cookies, and paleo-friendly ingredients, grilled to perfection on a robata grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, soy sauce, honey, sriracha sauce, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with coconut oil and sprinkle with crushed peanut cookies.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional peanut cookies and sriracha sauce if desired.
Let the skewers rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
